integrity: The stated spectrum and 17-point projector are verified by pure-integer exact enumeration and a separate unnormalized 2^15 Walsh transform; the analytic translation-averaging proof establishes global optimality.
scientific_limitations: Petersen graph only; finite six-dimensional exact Walsh census; earlier unindexed equivalent character tables cannot be excluded. The claimed optimum is proved for real and complex projections, without symmetry restrictions. No independent audit has been performed.
title: Pentagon Walsh spectrum and the sparse sharp projection for the Petersen graph
